<!-- remark-1: body_md -->
The bounds $g_{\min}$ and $g_{\max}$ define the allowable reference-search
interval.
For the numerical examples considered in this paper, the upper search
bound is chosen as
    $g_{\max}
    =
    r_k,$
so that the governor does not search above the desired reference.
The lower bound $g_{\min}$ allows the governed reference to move below
both the desired and previously applied references when required by the
predicted constraints.
<!-- end remark-1 -->
